policy: Frozen blood_constraints readings and passes(), primary reading only. Robustness: the exact pre-filter of P2I-2X first; each case at each case-compatible position, read U-OUT, U-HB, FD-BLD-08, FD-BLD-06 until its first readable failure; joint survivors are the product of the cases' surviving positions per shared set and common rate; UNREADABLE never counts as a failure. Crystalloid: Finf > F0 is an ANALYTIC_REJECTION; FD-BLD-04 and 05 read the bag alone in both cases; FD-BLD-06 reads every predeclared certified blood probe in both cases (the same probe); primary survival needs FD-BLD-06 at some probe, robust at every probe, isolated at the reference. Secondary consequences (output, Hb, DO2, deficit) are reported, never filtered. No lactate, legacy trajectory, SBP or MAP is read.
